title: Real-World Integration & Demonstration Environment
design_decisions: demo script targets the real HTTP API, not service internals
demo data isolation comes from existing DEVICE_BACKEND=memory default architecture, not a special demo mode built for this phase
reset = restart, since no DELETE endpoint exists on the real API and inventing one was out of scope

real_defect_found.description: MockDetector.detect() hardcoded detections=[], making /devices/register completely non-functional against the deployed mock pipeline in any environment lacking trained weights (every CI run, fresh clone, and this demo environment, permanently)
real_defect_found.root_cause: every existing passing test for this endpoint used a test-local _FakeDetector substitute instead of the real MockDetector; zero tests pinned MockDetector's own empty-detections behavior
real_defect_found.fix: MockDetector.detect() now returns one deterministic synthetic Detection per call, using a label drawn from the canonical taxonomy (class_map.CANONICAL_CLASSES) rather than the detector's own non-canonical _DEVICE_TYPES vocabulary
real_defect_found.verification: full Python suite re-run at 1104/1105 (1 pre-existing unrelated flake), confirming a pure completion fix with no behavior change to anything that previously worked

live_verification.demo_run_2_no_reset: 10/10 steps succeeded, distinct device_id, no collision (fixed via unique capture_id per run after discovering deterministic device-ID derivation)
live_verification.reset_flag: docker compose restart device-ai succeeded, demo device returned 404 afterward
live_verification.real_data_safety: Postgres devices table showed 35 rows before, during, and after every demo run and reset

honest_scope_not_claimed: no live Hyperledger Fabric transaction — external anchor step is real API contract against in-memory implementation, explicitly labeled MOCKED in script output
no dashboard visualization of the demoed device — frontend Submission model and AI DeviceRecord/DevicePassport model remain architecturally disconnected, out of this phase's scope to fix
no literal consumer-role query — GET /devices/{id} stands in as the only real public read path, labeled as such

python_full_suite.note: 1 pre-existing unrelated benchmark-timing flake, documented since P6.2

tests.mypy_predictor_py: 0 new errors (4 pre-existing in transitively-checked untouched files)

security_considerations: demo script makes only unauthenticated calls to already-unauthenticated public device-lifecycle routes (pre-existing characteristic, not changed here)
no credentials/tokens/secrets in run_demo.py or README.md
